**Truthammer — 3 October 2026**
**An unwelcome tent guest**

A displacer beast enters Dain’s Leaky Tent and attacks twice. Both rolls fall below his AC; both attacks miss. Dain remains at 28 HP, wearing Dwarven Half Plate.

The direct attack alerts him to the immediate threat. The beast becomes Wet on entering: fire resistance and cold/lightning vulnerability under Leaky Tent’s custom rules.
